directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors
directionProbe.note: All four flagged characters (猾, 遑, 賄, 誨) led to a reorder and no flagged stroke was left as it stood. The endpoint assignment check added 晦 and 繪, whose strokes run in the same direction and differ only in order, and the corrected order leaves no pair over 60°.

subThresholdSlants.method: direction-probe rows recomputed against the corrected order: 6 rows between 45° and 60°, none corrected
subThresholdSlants.note: Four are short dots the dictionary draws vertically while the licensed corpora slant them (宦 1, 麾 1, 痕 1, 歆 1) and two are the short strokes of 恢 6 and 彙 2. Kept as licensed geometry, as in the earlier batches.

sourceTransform.note: serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y); no glyph in this batch carries a horizontal offset.
